title: Self-Conditioned [A,B,C,D]
text: Implement state-space controller in self-conditioned form, 2 inputs, 1 output, {D-matrix} sets D -matrix of the state-space implementation; {A-matrix} sets a -matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix} sets the b -matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix} sets the c -matrix of the state-space implementation, {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states and {Poles of A-H*C} sets the desired poles. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix
params.values: A -matrix of the state-space implementation [-1 -0.2;0 -3] (default) | array

params.name: B-matrix
params.values: B -matrix of the state-space implementation [1;1] (default) | array

params.name: C-matrix
params.values: C -matrix of the state-space implementation [1 0] (default) | array

params.name: D-matrix
params.values: D -matrix of the state-space implementation 0.02 (default) | array | scalar
